title: perf(mobile): thread composer, route screen and queue control compile with the React Compiler
body:
The React Compiler skipped the thread composer, the thread route screen, the queue control, and the composer state hook. Those are the screen and hooks that re-render while a reply streams.

| File | Was skipped for | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `ThreadComposer`, `ThreadRouteScreen`, `ThreadQueueControl`, `state/use-thread-composer-state` | `try` without `catch` (7 sites) | the guarded body is an async function, with `.finally()` chained |
| `ThreadRouteScreen` | inspector-toggle action ref written during render | written in a layout effect |
| `ThreadQueueControl` | queue drag handle read its latest-props ref while building the pan gesture | callbacks through `useEffectEvent`; the gesture is rebuilt only when `disabled` changes |

Manual `useMemo`/`useCallback`/`memo` are removed from all four files. The remaining clock read in `ThreadComposer` sits in a press handler, not in render. `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`: 22 → 18.

**Verified on device** (Pixel 9 API 36 emulator, isolated server, real Claude provider):
- Opened a seeded thread, typed in the composer, and sent a turn; the reply streamed in.
- While it ran I queued a second message. The queue pill showed "1 queued", and the message was sent "from queue" when the turn ended.
- No red box, and no `useMemoCache` or React errors in the Metro log.

**Renders while a reply streams in the open thread** (`measure-renders` stream scenario, median of 3, same base and device):

| | Before | After |
|---|---:|---:|
| renders | 1302 | 1343 |
| commits | 34 | 35 |
| runs | 1682 / 1249 / 1302 | 1243 / 1343 / 1876 |

No measurable change. Provider output length varies, so each side's own spread is wider than the difference between them. `ThreadFeed`, which renders the messages, is still on `KNOWN_BAILOUTS`, so the streaming hot path is mostly unmemoized either way.

## Review follow-up

- Queue reorder/steer/remove/resume, merge back, work locally and queued-edit save await commands directly. The send lock and `prepareTurnAttachments` (which can throw) use `settlePromise`. A failed upload during a queued edit now alerts instead of leaving the save spinner up.
- `inspectorToggleActionRef` is gone; the toggle reads `inspectorMode` at call time.
- Not exercised on device: no provider runs on the isolated server.

Device: Pixel 9 API 36 emulator on nucbox-1, client rebuilt from `perf/mobile-compile-8` (the old one lacked the `T3FoldPosture` native view), Metro and an isolated seeded server on cups.

Claude Opus 5.5 via Claude Code.
